generator_rejection: batch rejects only semantic duplicates; 28 fresh seeded draws and 52 boundary/profile records have distinct IDs. No role-dependent rejection. Invalid explicit parameters rejected; canonical practice request rejected.
delivery: Actual prepare_records: controlled 52 -> 52, random 28 -> 28, runner 5 -> 5, all easy. No removed decision cases at captured basis 5370. New profile q-20589 occurs in random survivors; q-20598 in runner survivors; all restored role/mask combinations survive controlled filtering.

learner_selection.configured_positive_easy_weight: All delivered records are easy. select groups by rating then chooses uniformly among all candidates in the chosen easy band using hash draw. Thus role/mask/profile membership and shortcut proportions remain the same in the conditional easy distribution; sorting entity IDs changes the seed-to-question mapping, not support or conditional probability.
learner_selection.zero_easy_weight: No newly generated easy record is selectable through a positively weighted rated band; not replaced by unrated fallback.
learner_selection.unconfigured_policy: select chooses candidates.first(); this can deliver one deterministic item, but no policy snapshot supplied and no claim about active live policy.
learner_selection.history: seen_before_task removes previously encountered entity IDs; caller excludes current prefix. Can reduce any particular learner subset; exact history not supplied. No answer-role-specific rule.
learner_selection.limits: Exact seed-to-item output cannot be known before database entity IDs, active policy and learner history exist. Analytic branch/support examination only; no simulated live learner or publication.
